Some crap.

September 25, 2009

Man.. it’s been a while. But I am back. Here is an evoking song:

Lyrics of the day: Gui Boratto (No Turning Back)

Take a chance in those wonderful words you just don’t understand.

I can show you the way but I know that you’ll never be there.

All the time, all the shine of your eyes I would never forget.

All I know there’s no time, there’s no life, there is no turning back.

Feeling stuck and lost. Sudden urge for liquor. Maybe I’ll leave early today and have a party of my own, in my own world. :) Nothing better than romancing yourself.
He he.. I think; I am thoughtdrunk. :) I think I am gonna buy an i-pod today. I have been needing/wanting a music player for a long time.

See.. thats depression shopping, but I guess it’s gonna happen. :) Cheers.
